proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13291 *savēla lists Punjabi saver/saverā, Hindi sawerā, Nepali/Kumaoni saber and Gujarati saverā. It discusses b through emphatic vv or influence of ber; the modern r/b variants are supported without asserting a unique deeper pathway.
